meta.title: ANANDA Cocktails — Premium Pouch Cocktails
meta.description: Premium, bar-strength pouch cocktails mixed for the makers, the movers, and the midnight sun. No glass, no pretence — just pure, uninhibited joy, ready wherever you are.

about.p2: No glass, no pretence. Just pure, uninhibited joy – ready whenever and wherever you are.

step1.label: [Step 01]
step1.title: Chill
step1.body: Submerge the pouch in ice or drop it in the freezer.

step2.label: [Step 02]
step2.title: Twist
step2.body: Twist open the high-flow cap. Ditch the bottle openers, the sticky counters, and the heavy glass.

step3.label: [Step 03]
step3.title: Sip
step3.body: Sip it straight from the pouch on the dance floor, or pour it over crushed ice under the sun. Be entirely right here, right now.
